subs.zh: 大多数工厂，是把东西装起来。

subs.en: The one inside you takes them apart.
subs.zh: 你身体里这一座，专门拆。

subs.en: An acid drum churns it all to paste,
subs.zh: 酸液滚筒把它搅成一团糊，

subs.en: and a gatekeeper lets it out, a spoonful at a time.
subs.zh: 看门人一次只放出去一勺。

subs.en: On the sorting line, the sandwich comes apart:
subs.zh: 到了分拣线，三明治被拆开：

subs.en: bread into sugar, ham into amino acids,
subs.zh: 面包变成糖，火腿变成氨基酸，

subs.en: The liver shelves the sugar, and it waits.
subs.zh: 肝把糖码上货架，然后等着。
6 个小时以后：公交车来了。

subs.en: Down the arteries, into tiny furnaces.
subs.zh: 顺着动脉，送进一个个小熔炉。

subs.en: Taken apart, lunch becomes the strength to run.
subs.zh: 拆开了的午饭，变成你奔跑的力气。
